posts.topic: Fraud Prevention Rose. Losses Rose Too.
posts.hook: Record fraud prevention did not stop losses from rising. The gap is timing, not rules.
posts.key_stat: UK fraud losses hit £1.28B in 2025, up 4% despite £1.68B prevented.
posts.source: UK Finance Annual Fraud Report 2026, via Neopay
posts.visual_direction: Clean stat card contrasting record prevention against still-rising losses to frame detection lag as the real problem.
